data.body: REVISED ROOT CAUSE (deeper investigation): The pre-commit hook is a secondary symptom. PRIMARY root cause is that 4 ticket-push sites use 'git push origin tickets' which resolves to pushing the LOCAL refs/heads/tickets ref (stale at 5a405f88... when investigated). Because .tickets-tracker operates in detached-HEAD mode, ticket-event commits advance HEAD but do NOT update refs/heads/tickets. All push attempts therefore push a stale ref and fail as non-fast-forward against origin/tickets (which is well ahead). The retry loop in _push_tickets_branch (ticket-lib.sh:686-742) merges origin/tickets into the detached HEAD but then retries the same stale-ref push, exhausting 3 retries with 'tickets branch push failed after 3 retries'. EMPIRICAL EVIDENCE: 'git push origin tickets' from .tickets-tracker -> exit 1, 'non-fast-forward' (rejected because local refs/heads/tickets is behind origin/tickets); 'git push origin HEAD:tickets' -> success (pushes the detached-HEAD commit object directly). FIX: change 'git push origin tickets' -> 'git push origin HEAD:tickets' in all 4 sites: ticket-lib.sh:700, merge-to-main-direct.sh:864, ticket-lifecycle.sh:210, ticket_graph/_links.py:157. Additionally, add PRE_COMMIT_ALLOW_NO_CONFIG=1 to _links.py subprocess env (defense in depth).
